title: BC-5000 Cordless Battery Capacity Tester – Cordless Battery Capacity Tester
description: Automatic shut off when end point voltage is reached Capacity tests all 12 and 24 V Lead Acid batteries Powered by battery during test Programmable from 10-50 Ah discharge in 1Ah increments Results displayed in percent of discharge for ease of interpretation Incorporates automatic over temperature protection and protection from reverse polarity set up Audio alert when capacity test is complete
